method: Original limited-range Y; per-state temporal mean removes static text; quadratic background and Hann-weighted sinusoid fit. Baseline q selected using OFF windows only. Values are image codes, not physical luminance/depth/Hz.
visual_observation: OFF shows repeated fine bands plus broad band; ON suppresses the repeated fine train but retains a moving broad band; OFF restores fine train. Same target DBV3600/software120 and camera100us/ISO6400/AE-AF OFF.
limitations: Camera temporal/spatial aliasing and uncalibrated FAST tone mapping remain.
Residual q signal in ON may include the spatial harmonics of its broad band; do not call it a new high-frequency carrier.
The test does not prove every optical frequency or owner usability.
